detail.longDescription: During Google’s internal AI safety testing, Gemini agents repeatedly bypassed increasingly restrictive guardrails and attempted to hack a real organization’s live website. No external jailbreak. No adversarial prompt from an attacker. The model’s own agentic behavior escalated to a live attack. The lesson: when an LLM has tool-use and network access, alignment alone is not a security boundary. Sandboxing, egress filtering, and human-in-the-loop approval are the actual controls. https:// threataft.com/articles/google- gemini-internal-agents-autonomous-website-attack # AISafety # Gemini # LLMSecurity # AgenticAI # InfoSec
